items.name: dot-think
items.title: Dot Think
items.description: A sphere of dots spinning on its vertical axis, with far-side dots shrinking and fading for depth.

items.name: dot-ponder
items.title: Dot Ponder
items.description: A still dot sphere where each row takes a full 360° turn in a staggered wave from top to bottom.

items.name: dot-process
items.title: Dot Process
items.description: A still dot sphere where each ring pushes outward and settles back into place in a staggered wave from top to bottom.

items.name: dot-work
items.title: Dot Work
items.description: A dot sphere where a narrow wave travels down, pulling a few rows of dots inward as it passes.

items.name: dot-reason
items.title: Dot Reason
items.description: A dot sphere that scrambles and solves itself like a twisty cube, one row or column turn at a time.

items.name: dot-read
items.title: Dot Read
items.description: A still dot sphere where a thin band of light reads down from top to bottom, for reading a file.

items.name: dot-transfer
items.title: Dot Transfer
items.description: A dot sphere where a wave pushes rows outward on its way up and fades them off the top, for uploading or downloading.

items.name: dot-search
items.title: Dot Search
items.description: A still dot sphere where one lit column sweeps around the axis like a radar with a short fading trail, for searching.

items.name: dot-compact
items.title: Dot Compact
items.description: A dot sphere where two inward waves leave the poles and meet at the equator as a thin waist, for compacting context.

items.name: dot-parallel
items.title: Dot Parallel
items.description: A dot sphere where several narrow waves travel down at once, evenly spaced, for parallel tool calls and subagents.

items.name: square-think
items.title: Square Think
items.description: A flat square of dots where a ring of swollen dots spreads from the center to the edge.

items.name: square-idle
items.title: Square Idle
items.description: A flat square of dots that grows and shrinks together, with optional center-to-edge ripple.

items.name: square-process
items.title: Square Process
items.description: A flat square of dots that breathes in a sweep from left to right.

items.name: square-load
items.title: Square Load
items.description: A flat square of dots that swells ring by ring until full, then shrinks back the same way.

items.name: square-read
items.title: Square Read
items.description: A flat square of dots read row by row, like eyes moving across lines of text. For reading a file.

items.name: square-edit
items.title: Square Edit
items.description: A flat square of dots where a few rows are typed in, like the changed lines of a diff. For editing a file.

items.name: square-stream
items.title: Square Stream
items.description: A flat square of dots where output lines land row by row, the newest brightest, like a terminal. For running a command.

items.name: square-plan
items.title: Square Plan
items.description: A flat square of dots that ticks forward to a stop, blinks, then carries on or steps back, like a plan being worked and revised.

items.name: circle-think
items.title: Circle Think
items.description: A flat circle of dots where a ring of swollen dots spreads from the center to the edge.

items.name: circle-idle
items.title: Circle Idle
items.description: A flat circle of dots that grows and shrinks together, with optional center-to-edge ripple.

items.name: circle-process
items.title: Circle Process
items.description: A flat circle of dots that breathes in a sweep from left to right.

items.name: circle-load
items.title: Circle Load
items.description: A flat circle of dots that swells ring by ring until full, then shrinks back the same way.

items.name: circle-ping
items.title: Circle Ping
items.description: A flat circle of dots sending a ring out and getting a fainter echo back. For a tool call or request.

items.name: circle-upload
items.title: Circle Upload
items.description: A flat circle of dots where rings swell from the edge inward and the center pops, as if bundled and sent. For uploading.

items.name: circle-await
items.title: Circle Await
items.description: A flat circle of dots resting dim while the center beats slowly, like a heartbeat. For waiting on user approval.

items.name: circle-search
items.title: Circle Search
items.description: A flat circle of dots swept by a turning wedge that leaves a fading trail, like radar. For searching the web.

items.name: noise-think
items.title: Noise Think
items.description: Thin concentric rings warped by smooth Perlin noise, rippling in soft curves.

items.name: noise-respond
items.title: Noise Respond
items.description: Noise rings with a push travelling outward from the innermost ring, like a drop landing in water.

items.name: noise-listen
items.title: Noise Listen
items.description: Noise rings whose wobble swells, calms almost to circles, and swells again.

items.name: noise-ponder
items.title: Noise Ponder
items.description: Noise rings turning around the center, inner rings trailing behind so the shape twists.

items.name: noise-decide
items.title: Noise Decide
items.description: Noise rings closing up into one bright line, holding, then fanning back out.

items.name: noise-voice
items.title: Noise Voice
items.description: Noise rings whose wobble follows a level prop, for voice or audio input.

items.name: noise-transfer
items.title: Noise Transfer
items.description: Noise rings born calm at the center, flowing out to fade at the edge. For uploading or downloading.

items.name: noise-stream
items.title: Noise Stream
items.description: Noise rings where each token sends a small push out from the center, at uneven gaps. For streaming an answer.

items.name: noise-analyze
items.title: Noise Analyze
items.description: Noise rings pulling tight and bright around one ring, the lens moving slowly in and out. For deep reading or analysis.

items.name: noise-search
items.title: Noise Search
items.description: Noise rings whose wobble grows ring by ring from the center into tight ripples, then calms. For a broad search.

items.name: arc-load
items.title: Arc Load
items.description: Concentric rings broken into arcs, turning steadily around the center.

items.name: arc-work
items.title: Arc Work
items.description: Arcs whose heads run ahead and tails catch up, stretching and shrinking as they turn.

items.name: arc-plan
items.title: Arc Plan
items.description: Rings of arcs that each turn exactly one arc and hold, stepping inward like the dials of a lock.

items.name: arc-assemble
items.title: Arc Assemble
items.description: Rings of arcs whose cuts close into whole rings and reopen, one ring after another going inward.

items.name: arc-process
items.title: Arc Process
items.description: Rings of arcs pulling inward and letting go, the pull travelling from the outer ring to the inner one.

items.name: arc-run
items.title: Arc Run
items.description: Rings of arcs turning at whole-number speed ratios, so their cuts line up on a regular beat.

items.name: arc-think
items.title: Arc Think
items.description: Rings of arcs turning steadily, each arc fading from a bright head to a faint tail.

items.name: arc-search
items.title: Arc Search
items.description: Rings of arcs clicking round like a lock trying combinations, then lining up. For searching or matching.

items.name: arc-write
items.title: Arc Write
items.description: Rings of arcs that draw themselves on and erase from the tail, one ring after another going inward. For writing or editing.

items.name: arc-parallel
items.title: Arc Parallel
items.description: Rings of arcs each turning at its own pace; finished rings close, dim and stop. For tool calls running in parallel.

items.name: arc-transfer
items.title: Arc Transfer
items.description: Rings of arcs whose outer ring lights clockwise from 12 o'clock up to a progress. For an upload or download.

items.name: bar-think
items.title: Bar Think
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with a bright head trailing a fading tail as it travels round.

items.name: bar-parallel
items.title: Bar Parallel
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with several evenly spaced waves moving them out or in as they travel round.

items.name: bar-read
items.title: Bar Read
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with a small wave lighting them at a steady pace, like reading down lines.

items.name: bar-write
items.title: Bar Write
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, typed in bursts until the ring is written, then wiped in order.

items.name: bar-search
items.title: Bar Search
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with a wave that runs ahead, backs up and runs on, like searching.

items.name: bar-stream
items.title: Bar Stream
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with short pulses chasing round at uneven gaps, like tokens arriving.

items.name: bar-transfer
items.title: Bar Transfer
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle that fills to a progress, its leading bar pulsing, like an upload or download.

items.name: bar-ping
items.title: Bar Ping
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle, with a pulse going out to 6 o'clock and back, like a request and its response.

items.name: bar-plan
items.title: Bar Plan
items.description: A fence of thin bars around a circle cut into steps: done steps hold, the current one sweeps, the rest wait.

items.name: dot-globe
items.title: Dot Globe
items.description: Every dot-sphere animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.

items.name: dot-square
items.title: Dot Square
items.description: Every square-sheet animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.

items.name: dot-circle
items.title: Dot Circle
items.description: Every circle-sheet animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.

items.name: noise-rings
items.title: Noise Rings
items.description: Every noise-ring animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.

items.name: arc-rings
items.title: Arc Rings
items.description: Every arc-ring animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.

items.name: bar-ring
items.title: Bar Ring
items.description: Every bar-ring animation in one component; the animation prop switches between them.
